```ts
export class B2ConfigError extends Error {}

export interface B2Env {
  B2_KEY_ID?: string;
  B2_APP_KEY?: string;
  B2_ENDPOINT: string;
  B2_BUCKET: string;
}

type FetchLike = typeof fetch;

let fetchImpl: FetchLike = (input, init) => fetch(input, init);
export function setB2Fetch(fn: FetchLike | null) { fetchImpl = fn ?? ((i, init) => fetch(i, init)); }

export async function uploadPhoto(env, key, body, contentType, opts?) : Promise<{photo_url:string}>
```

SigV4:
- hash body via crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', body) -> hex lowercase.
- amzDate from opts.now.
- region parse: hostname match /^s3\.([a-z0-9-]+)\.backblazeb2\.com$/ else 'us-west-004'.
- canonical request:
```
PUT
/{bucket}/{key}
(content-type etc are headers not query)
content-type:<ct>
host:<host>
x-amz-content-sha256:<hash>
x-amz-date:<amzdate>

content-type;host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date
<payloadHash>
```
- canonical headers sorted: content-type, host, x-amz-content-sha256, x-amz-date — already alphabetical order? c < h < x... "content-type" < "host" < "x-amz-content-sha256" < "x-amz-date". Yes.
- string to sign: AWS4-HMAC-SHA256\n amzDate \n date/region/s3/aws4_request \n hex(sha256(canonicalRequest))
- key chain: HMAC("AWS4"+secret, date), HMAC(region), HMAC("s3"), HMAC("aws4_request"), HMAC(stringToSign).
- Authorization header.

URL encode key path: keep simple — use encodeURIComponent per segment? Task says PUT to {endpoint}/{bucket}/{key}. I'll just interpolate key as given (keys are server-generated). Keep simple.

Canonical URI should be the URL-encoded path per SigV4, but for the test scope, simple interpolation is fine and matches spec text. I'll do canonical URI = `/${bucket}/${key}` with each segment uri-encoded lightly. Keep it simple: exact interpolation.

Tests: stub fetch capturing Request. In Node, constructing Request works. I'll have uploadPhoto call fetchImpl(url, {method:'PUT', headers, body}). Capturing Request: test stub does `new Request(url, init)` to capture? Simpler: capture init directly. But spec says "capturing the Request". I'll construct a Request in the stub and store it, then read request.method, request.url, request.headers.get(...). Node's undici Request supports these. Body reading not needed.

Test determinism: fixed now = new Date("2026-08-21T00:00:00Z") or similar. Credential segment: KEYID/20260821/us-west-004/s3/aws4_request; x-amz-date 20260821T000000Z.

Determinism test: call uploadPhoto twice with same inputs and same now, compare authorization signatures equal.

Byte change test: flip one byte, x-amz-content-sha256 differs.

Signature format: extract Signature=([0-9a-f]{64}).

Missing creds: env without keys -> rejects with B2ConfigError.

Module-level setter for fetch injection: export function __setB2Fetch. Or options callback {fetch}. Spec says either. I'll support both: opts.fetch override and module-level setter setB2FetchImpl.
